The image shows a close-up view of biological tissue containing numerous small, pale, yellowish-white nodular lesions scattered throughout. Because these abnormalities are visible to the naked eye (as evidenced by the metric ruler for scale) and not just under a microscope, they are considered **gross lesions**.
